_about: The stage's backdrop (lingjing.js paintBackdrop, atmos.js backdropOf): one painting per weather kind (rules/weather.mjs KINDS — the scene's own `weather` tag, else the real sky, else 蒙山's seasons), by day and by night. The twelve are being painted (2026-10-14) and not yet picked: every slot points at a stand-in until Hanli picks, so swapping the picks in is this file only. A scene may declare its own picture (`backdrop`), and a set piece or a beast's 出场 brings its own.
